name: Kazama Akane
source:
A second-year student at Seitei Gakuen.

Daughter of Yumiko, she is an individualistic and manipulative person who is a modern girl. She has noticed that her parents are not getting along well, and even though she respects her mother, she criticizes her relationship with her father, saying that she needs to rethink her relationship with him.

Her youthful body, which is beginning to mature from a “girl” to a “woman,” is very attractive to men. Akane falls in love at first sight with Takaya, a trainee teacher, but she discovers his feelings for Yumiko. With a faint sense of rivalry with her mother, she tells Takaya of her feelings for him, hoping to turn his attention to her.
